note: Example submodule for HTTP Client Manager. Declares service APIs example_services / example_services_yaml (base_uri http://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com) with commands FindPosts/FindPost/CreatePost/FindComments, plus shipped http_config_request entities all_posts, find_post (postId 1), create_post (token params), an injectable client service example_api.http_client and a typed wrapper (api: posts). Medium introspects the shipped find_post config entity (its postId is set to a known value by setup and restored to '1' by cleanup); hard has the agent create a FindComments config request verified against live config. Test entities namespaced hcme_eval_*.

evals.prompt: In the HTTP Client Manager example submodule, what is the service API id it defines and which remote base URI does it target?
evals.expected_output: It defines example_services (and example_services_yaml), both with base_uri http://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com.

evals.prompt: Which operations/commands does the HTTP Client Manager example API expose for posts?
evals.expected_output: FindPosts (GET posts), FindPost (GET posts/{postId}), CreatePost (POST posts), FindComments (GET comments).

evals.prompt: What ready-made HTTP Config Requests and demo pages does the HTTP Client Manager example submodule ship?
evals.expected_output: Config requests all_posts (FindPosts), find_post (FindPost, postId 1) and create_post (CreatePost with tokens); demo routes /find-posts/{postId}, /create-post and their -advanced variants.

evals.prompt: On this site, inspect the shipped 'find_post' HTTP Config Request from the example submodule and report the postId parameter it is currently set to.
Using the example_services API, create an HTTP Config Request with id 'hcme_eval_build' that runs the FindComments command with the parameter postId set to 2. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create an http_config_request id=hcme_eval_build, service_api=example_services, command_name=FindComments, parameters={postId: 2}.
